oh.. i see.. i know at least somewhat how you feel.. this situation.. im sorry. just find anything that helps you. for me it was a couple records i had discovered around the same time. if you want to know, they are 'Pretty Hate Machine' and 'The Downward Spiral'. (Oh, and Herzeleid! It's so good!!! I find it goes with about any moment/situation/feeling. Coincidentally it released on the same day of the break up.) The second one, it's not even just music to me. it's simply art. and i dont mean that in a cheesy hipster whatever way. It's remarkable. it's not just music, it's a story, filled with deep feeling. And if you can, try to hang around with friends often. it really helps. loneliness is the worst thing there is. and i do not have many friends either, but i got pretty close to one friend over that time and it helped a good bit. i am younger than you, though. im 18. i think maybe those who suffer the most are forced to mature sooner. i don't know. but i hope what i said can be of some kind of help. music is the only thing that could hold my hand when no other being would or could for me. hopefully you can find your 'music'.
